meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: 收到科学数据文件路径后,自动识别格式,查对应参考文档,做缺失值、泄漏、异常值与统计分布检查,生成含文件信息、数据质量、处理建议的 Markdown 报告,并保存为「原文件名_eda_report.md」。
howto.when: 当用户提供科学数据文件路径,或要求探索/分析/总结某个数据文件、评估数据质量、询问适合的分析方法时触发。

say.text: 帮我探索一下 reads.fastq,看看序列质量和长度分布。
say.note: 会按 FASTQ 格式生成 EDA 报告。

say.text: 分析 experiment_results.csv 的缺失值和异常值。
say.note: 会输出针对表格数据的统计与质量检查。

say.text: 看一下 cells.nd2 有哪些通道和维度?
say.note: 会读取显微镜图像元数据并生成报告。

howto.what_en: Given a scientific file path, it detects the format, consults the matching reference, checks missing values/leakage/outliers/distributions, then writes a Markdown EDA report (metadata, quality, recommendations) as {original_filename}_eda_report.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user gives a scientific data file path, or asks to explore/analyze/summarize a file, assess data quality, or asks what analysis fits.

say_en.text: Explore reads.fastq and check sequence quality and length distribution.
say_en.note: Generates an EDA report for FASTQ format.

say_en.text: Analyze missing values and outliers in experiment_results.csv.
say_en.note: Runs quality and statistical checks for tabular data.

say_en.text: What channels and dimensions does cells.nd2 have?
say_en.note: Reads microscopy image metadata and creates a report.
